cohort: 40 patients diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus between 24-28 weeks of gestation who delivered at a tertiary care hospital in Gujarat, India between February 2020 and May 2022.
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus is associated with higher maternal and fetal morbidity.
mod_finding: 67.5% of patients with GDM underwent cesarean delivery and 32.5% had a normal vaginal delivery.
